name: GMK CYL TA Neo

description: GMK CYL TA Neo — a returning classic colorway in Base, Extensions, R5, BAE, and Deutsche Mods kits, running June 19–July 17 2026 via Divinikey (NA), Oblotzky Industries (EU), Prototypist (UK), and other regional vendors including zFrontier (China).
